딸.e: Paired with 아들: 아들딸 = 'sons and daughters'.

공항.x: It takes an hour by bus to the airport.

길.x: The traffic is really bad. (lit. The road is very blocked.)
길.e: Also means 'way' or method. 길을 잃었어요 = I got lost.
길.t: 길을 건너다 = to cross the street; 길을 묻다 = to ask for directions.

문.x: It's cold. Please close the door.
문.t: Common pair: 문을 열다 (open the door) · 문을 닫다 (close the door; also 'a shop closes').

닦다.m: to wipe, to clean, to polish; to brush (teeth)
닦다.x: I brush my teeth after eating.
닦다.e: 이를 닦다 = brush your teeth. Don't confuse with 닫다 (close).

흐리다.x: The weather is a bit cloudy today.
흐리다.e: 흐림 = 'cloudy' on weather forecasts. Opposite: 맑다.

참.x: The sky is really clear and pretty today.
참.e: Also a native noun meaning 'truth', as in 참말 'true words'.
참.t: Said alone, 참! means 'Oh, right!' when you suddenly remember something.

장례식.x: People usually wear black to a funeral.
장례식.e: Literally 'burial rite ceremony'; -식 = ceremony: 결혼식, 졸업식.
장례식.t: Pronounced [장녜식] — ㄹ becomes ㄴ after ㅇ.

등장하다.m: to appear, to make an entrance, to emerge
등장하다.ex: 이 영화에는 유명한 배우가 많이 등장해요.
등장하다.x: Lots of famous actors appear in this movie.

비기다.m: to tie, to draw (in a game)
비기다.x: Yesterday's soccer game ended in a 1-1 tie.
비기다.e: The noun for a tie game is the Sino-Korean word 무승부.
비기다.t: Use 와/과 for the opponent: 그 팀과 비겼어요 means 'We tied with that team.'

불안감.ex: 시험을 앞두고 불안감 때문에 잠을 못 잤어요.
불안감.x: Ahead of the exam, I couldn't sleep because of anxiety.
불안감.t: Pronounced [부란감]; the usual verb is 느끼다: 불안감을 느끼다.

출판사.x: My older sister works as an editor at a publishing company.

텀블러.ex: 텀블러를 가져가면 커피를 싸게 살 수 있어요.
텀블러.x: If you bring a tumbler, you can get coffee for less.
텀블러.e: From English 'tumbler'; in Korea it means a reusable, usually insulated, travel cup.

펼치다.m: to unfold, open (a book), spread out; to carry out, unfold (an event)
펼치다.x: Okay, everyone, open your textbooks to page 30.
펼치다.t: 꿈을 펼치다 means to make your dreams come true.

발 없는 말이 천 리 간다.de: 발 없는 말이 천 리 간다
발 없는 말이 천 리 간다.pr: 발 엄는 마리 철 리 간다
발 없는 말이 천 리 간다.forms: 발 없는 말이 천 리 간다고 / 발 없는 말이 천 리 가요
발 없는 말이 천 리 간다.m: word spreads fast; rumors travel far
발 없는 말이 천 리 간다.ex: 발 없는 말이 천 리 간다고 하니까 말조심하세요.
발 없는 말이 천 리 간다.x: They say words travel fast, so be careful what you say.
발 없는 말이 천 리 간다.e: Pun: 말 means both 'word' and 'horse'—a footless 'horse' still travels a thousand li.
발 없는 말이 천 리 간다.t: 없는 is pronounced [엄는], and 천 리 is [철리].
rel: 낮말은 새가 듣고 밤말은 쥐가 듣는다

양상.ex: 경기는 시간이 갈수록 다른 양상으로 흘러갔어요.
양상.x: As time went on, the game took a different turn.
양상.e: Literally 'shape and appearance': how a situation looks as it unfolds.
양상.t: 양상을 보이다 (to show a pattern) is a stock phrase in news reports.

유대감.m: sense of bond, feeling of connection
유대감.x: Traveling together deepened my bond with my friends.

특색.ex: 이 마을은 특색 있는 전통 음식으로 유명해요.
특색.x: This village is famous for its distinctive traditional food.
특색.e: Literally 'special color': what makes something stand out.
특색.t: 특색 is about standing out from others; 특성 is an inherent property of something.

에누리.ex: 에누리 좀 해 주시면 두 개 살게요.
에누리.x: If you give me a little off, I'll buy two.
에누리.e: Two senses: knocking down a price, or padding the truth.
에누리.t: 에누리 없다 means 'no haggling, fixed price' or 'no exaggeration, exactly as stated'.

짝사랑.ex: 저는 고등학교 때 한 선배를 오래 짝사랑했어요.
짝사랑.x: In high school, I had a crush on an older student for a long time.
짝사랑.e: 짝 'one of a pair' + 사랑 'love': love coming from just one side.
짝사랑.t: Use 짝사랑하다 as a verb: 누구를 짝사랑하다 means to secretly love someone who doesn't love you back.

통계적.ex: 두 집단 사이에 통계적으로 의미 있는 차이가 나타났습니다.
통계적.x: A statistically meaningful difference appeared between the two groups.

뒤섞이다.m: to be mixed up, to be jumbled, to mingle
뒤섞이다.x: I felt a mix of joy and sadness.
뒤섞이다.e: Passive of 뒤섞다 'to mix up thoroughly'.

몸부림치다.m: to struggle, to writhe, to thrash about; to strive desperately
몸부림치다.x: He struggled desperately all his life to escape poverty.
몸부림치다.e: 몸 'body' + 부림 (from 부리다 'to work, drive') + 치다: the whole body thrashing.
rel: to try with all one's might

덥석.m: eagerly, all at once (grabbing), snapping up
덥석.x: The child snatched up the candy as soon as he saw it.
덥석.e: A sound-symbolic word for a quick, greedy grab.
덥석.t: 덥석 믿다 means 'to believe too readily' — grabbing at something without thinking.

피땀을 흘리다.forms: 피땀을 흘려요 · 피땀을 흘렸어요 · 피땀 흘려 번 돈
피땀을 흘리다.m: to work one's fingers to the bone; to put in blood, sweat, and tears
피땀을 흘리다.ex: 부모님이 피땀을 흘려 모은 돈으로 집을 샀어요.
피땀을 흘리다.x: My parents bought a house with money they saved through blood, sweat, and tears.

연구비.ex: 정부가 대학의 연구비 지원을 늘리기로 했습니다.
연구비.x: The government decided to increase research funding for universities.

존재론.ex: 존재론은 존재한다는 것이 무엇인지 묻는 철학 분야입니다.
존재론.x: Ontology is the branch of philosophy that asks what it means to exist.

뜸.ex: 어제 한의원에 가서 배에 뜸을 떴어요.
뜸.x: Yesterday I went to a Korean medicine clinic and had moxibustion on my stomach.
뜸.t: The verb is 뜸을 뜨다; 뜸을 들이다 means 'to let rice steam' or 'to hesitate before speaking'.

명창.ex: 그녀는 오랜 수련 끝에 판소리 명창이 되었어요.
명창.x: After long training, she became a master pansori singer.
명창.e: Literally 'famous singing'; refers to the singer, too.

낙방.m: failing an exam (esp. the state exam)
낙방.x: He failed the state exam and went back to his hometown.
낙방.e: Literally 'falling off the list' of passers posted on a board.

면면히.ex: 이 전통은 수백 년 동안 면면히 이어져 왔습니다.
면면히.x: This tradition has continued unbroken for hundreds of years.
면면히.e: Literally 'like a thread, on and on': never breaking.
면면히.t: Don't confuse with the noun 면면 'faces, line-up': 참석자의 면면 'the line-up of attendees'.

의연히.m: resolutely, calmly and firmly, with composure
의연히.x: He handled it calmly and firmly even in a difficult situation.
